question: According to Census of India 2011, in which Union Territory was the highest population growth rate recorded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1) Dadra and Nagar Haveli**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dadra and Nagar Haveli** recorded the highest population growth rate among Union Territories according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The population growth rate in Dadra and Nagar Haveli was a significant indicator of demographic changes in the region.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and provides vital data on the demographic composition of the country.
 
• Understanding population growth rates helps in planning and implementing policies for sustainable development and resource allocation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India 2011** was the 15th National census since 1872.
 
• It provides comprehensive data on various parameters such as population size, growth, density, distribution, and literacy rates.
 
• The data from the Census is crucial for government planning, policy formulation, and administration at both the central and state levels.
 
• Union Territories like Dadra and Nagar Haveli often experience unique demographic trends due to factors such as migration, industrialization, and urbanization.
